================================================================================
                         WORKFLOW WRITING GUIDE
================================================================================

Step-by-step reference for creating GitHub Actions workflows.

================================================================================
                         FILE STRUCTURE TEMPLATE
================================================================================

```yaml
# =============================================================================
# {ENV} {Resource Name} Full Setup
# =============================================================================
# Brief description of what this workflow does
# Each job has its own lock - locked jobs skip to next, workflow continues
# =============================================================================

name: "[{ENV}] {Resource} - Full Setup"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Triggers: Manual dispatch or push to {branch}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - {branch}
    paths:
      - 'terraform/{env}/{path}/**'
      - 'ansible/{env}/playbooks/{resource}/**'
      - '.github/workflows/{this-file}.yml'

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Permissions: OIDC for AWS authentication
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Environment Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
env:
  ENVIRONMENT: {env}
  TF_WORKING_DIR: terraform/{env}/{path}
  ANSIBLE_HOST: 10.0.{subnet}.10
  ANSIBLE_USER: root

# =============================================================================
# Jobs
# =============================================================================
jobs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 1: {Job Description}
  # Lock: {ENV}_INFRA_{NAME}_LOCK
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  deploy:
    name: "1. {Job Display Name}"
    runs-on: mac-mini
    if: ${{ vars.{ENV}_INFRA_{NAME}_LOCK != 'true' }}
    ...
```

Separator hierarchy:
  ===== = file level
  ----- = section level (triggers, permissions, env)
  # --- = job level (indented, with lock variable documented)

================================================================================
                         SECTION HEADER FORMAT
================================================================================

```
# =============================================================================
# FILE LEVEL - Workflow title and description
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SECTION LEVEL - Triggers, Permissions, Env, etc.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # JOB LEVEL - Job description with lock variable
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

================================================================================
                         KEY DECISIONS
================================================================================

TRIGGERS
  - workflow_dispatch always included (manual override)
  - Paths include terraform/, ansible/, AND the workflow file itself
  - Branch matches environment: dev, prod, dev-security, prod-security

PERMISSIONS
  - id-token: write — required for OIDC
  - contents: read — required for checkout
  - Do NOT add actions: write unless auto-locking

ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES
  - ANSIBLE_HOST/ANSIBLE_USER defined at workflow top, not hardcoded in steps
  - DEV: subnet 63 (ANSIBLE=10.0.63.10, RUNNER=10.0.63.20)
  - PROD: subnet 53 (ANSIBLE=10.0.53.10, RUNNER=10.0.53.20)

SECRET FETCHING (CRITICAL)
  - Mask raw API_SECRET immediately after aws cli fetch
  - Then parse with jq, mask each parsed value separately
  - Mask combined values too (token_id=token_secret)
  - Use TF_VAR_ prefix for Terraform variables

  ```yaml
  - name: Fetch Proxmox Secrets
    run: |
      API_SECRET=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
        --secret-id {env}/proxmox/terraform-token \
        --query SecretString --output text)
      echo "::add-mask::${API_SECRET}"
      TOKEN_ID=$(echo "$API_SECRET" | jq -r '.token_id')
      TOKEN_SECRET=$(echo "$API_SECRET" | jq -r '.token_secret')
      echo "::add-mask::${TOKEN_ID}"
      echo "::add-mask::${TOKEN_SECRET}"
      echo "::add-mask::${TOKEN_ID}=${TOKEN_SECRET}"
      echo "TF_VAR_proxmox_api_token=${TOKEN_ID}=${TOKEN_SECRET}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
  ```

TERRAFORM
  - Always terraform init -upgrade (local mirror = no overhead)
  - timeout-minutes on plan (prevent hangs)
  - Save plan to file (-out=tfplan), apply uses saved plan

PASSING VARIABLES TO TERRAFORM
  - GITHUB_ENV pattern: when bash processing needed (JSON parsing, masking)
  - Inline -var pattern: when value comes directly from secrets/vars

MULTI-JOB PATTERN
  - First job: simple lock check
  - Subsequent jobs: always() + needs check + lock check
  ```yaml
  if: ${{ always() && needs.{prev}.result != 'failure' && needs.{prev}.result != 'cancelled' && vars.LOCK != 'true' }}
  ```
  This ensures locked/skipped upstream doesn't auto-skip downstream.

JOB RUNNER ASSIGNMENT
  - runs-on: mac-mini — Terraform jobs (talks to AWS + Proxmox API)
  - runs-on: {env}-local-runner — Ansible jobs (inside infrastructure network)

SSH OPERATIONS
  - Use env vars for host/user, never hardcoded IPs in steps
  - -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no for first connection
  - sshpass for password-based SSH (LXC provisioning)

================================================================================
                         COMMON MISTAKES
================================================================================

  arn:aws:iam:${{            → arn:aws:iam::${{ (double colon)
  canceled                   → cancelled (British spelling in GH Actions)
  {{ vars.NAME }}            → ${{ vars.NAME }} (missing $)
  terraform init             → terraform init -upgrade
  root@10.0.63.10            → ${{ env.ANSIBLE_USER }}@${{ env.ANSIBLE_HOST }}
  Mask after jq              → Mask immediately after aws cli fetch
  runs-on: macOS             → runs-on: mac-mini
  name: "Setup"              → name: "2. Setup Service" (numbered)
  Setup: (job ID)            → setup: (lowercase)

================================================================================
                         CHECKLIST BEFORE COMMIT
================================================================================

File Structure:
  [ ] File/section/job headers with correct separator hierarchy
  [ ] workflow_dispatch included
  [ ] Correct branch and paths triggers (include workflow file itself)

Environment:
  [ ] ENVIRONMENT matches branch
  [ ] No hardcoded IPs in steps (use env vars)

Secrets:
  [ ] API_SECRET masked immediately after fetch, before jq
  [ ] All parsed and combined values masked

Terraform:
  [ ] init -upgrade, timeout on plan, apply uses saved plan file

Multi-Job:
  [ ] Job names numbered, job IDs lowercase
  [ ] Subsequent jobs use always() pattern
  [ ] Lock variable documented in job header comment

================================================================================
